notes:
• You can now start a new ticket right from Add time in My time. Pick New ticket in the switch at the top, or click "Not in the list? Make a new ticket" under the ticket list, and its time goes on the same day.
• Time you've booked ahead, like PTO, now shows on the My time calendar with its hours.
• You can now log time on a ticket from My time on any day. Click Add, choose Time on a ticket, and pick the ticket, and its Log time opens already set to the day you're looking at.
• Internal time and New ticket in My time's Add menu now book on the day you're looking at, not always today.
